name: Jira Branch Link
description: Finds the Jira issue key (e.g. PROJ-123) in the focused workspace's branch name, shows it in the status bar, opens it in Jira and shows the issue in a sidebar panel.

commands.title: Jira: Open Issue for Current Branch

statusBarItems.tooltip: Open the Jira issue for this branch

settings.title: Jira URL
settings.description: Your Jira site: a full URL (https://jira.example.com) or just the Atlassian Cloud site name (your-company becomes https://your-company.atlassian.net). Issues open at <Jira URL>/browse/<KEY>.

settings.title: Other Jira sites by project key
settings.description: Optional, one per line: PROJECT=https://client.atlassian.net. Keys not listed use the Jira URL above.

settings.title: Atlassian account email
settings.description: Needed only to show issue details inside Orca (with an API token entered in the Jira Issue panel).

settings.title: Also match lowercase keys
settings.description: Find keys like feature/proj-123-login too. Off by default, because names such as fix-2-buttons would then look like issue keys.

settings.title: Show issue summary in the status bar
